details.description: No documentation on how to install, import, or set up the module in a project
details.why_required: Developers cannot use the code without knowing how to import it or what environment requirements exist
details.code_evidence: input.ts exports RetryOptions interface and fetchWithRetry function, but README.md provides no import instructions or environment requirements (e.g., fetch API availability)

details.description: No code examples showing how to call fetchWithRetry with actual parameters
details.why_required: Developers need to see practical examples to understand the correct function signature and usage patterns
details.code_evidence: fetchWithRetry accepts url:string and options?:RetryOptions parameters, but README.md contains no example calls demonstrating parameter usage

details.description: No documentation of function parameters, return type, or behavior
details.why_required: Developers need to know what parameters to pass, what the function returns, and when it throws errors
details.code_evidence: Function signature shows 'async function fetchWithRetry(url: string, options?: RetryOptions): Promise<string>' but no documentation explains parameters, return value, or error conditions

details.description: No documentation of the RetryOptions interface properties and their meanings
details.why_required: Developers need to know what configuration options are available and what they control
details.code_evidence: RetryOptions interface defines 'retries?: number' and 'delayMs?: number' properties but their purpose, units, and default values are not documented

details.description: Default values for retries and delayMs are not documented
details.why_required: Developers need to know what happens when options are omitted to predict default behavior
details.code_evidence: Code shows 'const retries = options?.retries ?? 3' and 'const delayMs = options?.delayMs ?? 1000' but these defaults are not documented in README.md

details.description: No documentation on what errors are thrown and when
details.why_required: Developers need to know how to handle errors and what exceptions to expect
details.code_evidence: Code throws 'new Error("Request failed")' when !res.ok and re-throws caught errors after retries exhausted, but README.md doesn't document error scenarios

details.description: No documentation of limitations like fixed delay, text-only response, or retry-on-all-errors behavior
details.why_required: Developers need to understand edge cases to avoid unexpected behavior in production
details.code_evidence: Code always uses 'res.text()' (not JSON), has fixed delay (not exponential), and retries on all errors including HTTP errors. These behaviors are not documented

details.description: Limited high-level description of project purpose and scope
details.why_required: Helps developers quickly understand if this library meets their needs
details.code_evidence: README.md only says 'Utility functions for network requests' without explaining the retry functionality or use cases
